user_visible_outcome: No visible change. Bookmark sync can no longer fail when two devices save the same chapter, and a deleted bookmark can no longer come back: removes win over older adds on every device, newer adds still work.
design: Server identity is the location (user, refsys, local_key), never the client id. pushAdd upserts on the 07 uniqueness constraint with ignore-duplicates. pushRemove writes a tombstone row first, then deletes the bookmark row. An add loses (acked, counted as suppressed) to a tombstone with a newer-or-equal timestamp and clears one it outranks. Pull applies tombstones to local rows they outrank with no outbox echo. Timestamp ties go to the delete; unparseable stamps stay pending. Implements the already-decided D3 tombstone-wins policy; cross-device clock skew near-simultaneous pairs is documented, not solved.
